sources.name: TravelHealthPro (UKHSA / NaTHNaC)
sources.role: Country health baseline (UK travel health guidance)
sources.reviewNote: 22 Oct 2026: travelhealthpro.org.uk/robots.txt allows /country pages; site states all content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where marked, excluding logos and the Crown emblem. Pages carry no stated date, so they corroborate only and cannot establish freshness. Third-party material marked otherwise on a page is not covered by the OGL; the builder quotes only the page's own text.
sources.reviewedBy: 03AA-04 builder agent, automated robots/licence check 22 Oct 2026 (no human review recorded)

sources.name: WMO World Weather Information Service
sources.role: Official climate averages (national meteorological services via WMO); forecasts are not used for baseline records
sources.reviewedBy: 03AA-04 builder agent, automated robots/licence/terms check 22 Oct 2026 (Cyprus time 22 Oct 2026); no human review recorded
sources.reviewNote: WMO's download guidance documents programmatic access at /en/json/[cityId]_en.json on conditions: acknowledge WWIS as the source, reproduce the information accurately, and the disclaimer applies. robots.txt allows /en/. The feed's short-range forecast block is never read.

sources.name: Ghana Standards Authority
sources.role: National standards body: plug and socket requirements
sources.reviewedBy: 03AA-04 builder agent, automated robots/licence/terms check 22 Oct 2026 (Cyprus time 22 Oct 2026); no human review recorded
sources.reviewNote: Statutory national standards body. robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/. The public notice states its effective date (1 Jan 2019); it is a requirement on importers and says nothing about older installed plug types. Fetched from the canonical gsa.gov.gh host; the www host fails TLS certificate verification and is not used.

sources.name: Ghana Public Utilities Regulatory Commission (legislative instruments it publishes)
sources.reviewedBy: 03AA-04 builder agent, automated robots/licence/terms check 22 Oct 2026 (Cyprus time 22 Oct 2026); no human review recorded
sources.reviewNote: Statutory regulator. robots.txt disallows only /cgi-bin/, /tmp/, /junk/. The instrument states its Gazette date (13 Jun 2008); later amendments are not checked.

sources.name: Energy Commission of Ghana
sources.role: Electricity sector regulator: National Electricity Grid Code
sources.reviewedBy: 03AA-04 builder agent, automated robots/licence/terms check 22 Oct 2026 (Cyprus time 22 Oct 2026); no human review recorded
sources.reviewNote: Statutory regulator. robots.txt allows all paths (Crawl-delay 3; one request per run). The Grid Code edition is dated October 2009 (month precision).
